attempts.reason: The case fixes price and discount_percent as create-time fields, so the item must be created via POST /api/v1/items/ with those values, and that POST must be the last data-carrying request. But REQUEST says auth is false, so the request under test would be sent with token=None, and the create route needs credentials. Creating a priced item anonymously is impossible with these tools. make.item() has no price field, and PUT also needs a token. No factory or route provides an anonymous path, so the final_price value cannot be produced and observed as required.

Contradiction between the case and the fixed data. The case requires an empty JSON object on PUT, but CASE_DATA fixes price '10.00' and discount_percent 15, and the rules require the request under test to carry every key in data exactly. Sending data would make it a non-empty update, and sending {} would violate the data rule. The case cannot be bound as specified.

The case needs an item with price 0.05 and discount_percent 50. make.item() accepts only owner, and the only route in scope is GET /api/v1/items/{id}, so no tool can set the price or discount. The fixture cannot be built, so the rounding tie cannot be exercised.

attempts.reason: The case requires observing final_price from the response to the request under test, but that request is a refused non-owner PUT (403 'Not enough permissions'), whose body never contains final_price. Any value observed from a separate GET is rejected because it is not in the response under test. The request under test is also anonymous (auth is false), so it cannot be made to succeed and return an item body. No available binding can supply the value from the response under test, so the case cannot be bound with these tools.
